body:
Relativistic Civilization Computation. Designs computing and communication systems that account for relativistic time, motion, and long-distance signal delays.

This database covers the technology as item 211 entry 94 of Manon's "100 Ultra-Advanced Future Technologies" catalog, section "Beyond the Apex: Extreme Speculative Technologies". It is the public edition: every factual claim below is drawn from real public science and engineering, honestly labeled.

Feasibility tier: theoretically plausible. Relativistic effects on computation are real (GPS clocks); civilization-scale relativistic system design is theoretical.

Classification: public database. This record profiles the technology; companion records cover known science, constraints, approaches, tools, unresolved problems, evidence, and outlook.

title: Relativistic Civilization Computation - Known Science Foundations
description: Public edition: Designs computing and communication systems that account for relativistic time, motion, and long-distance signal delays.
body:
Known science foundations of Relativistic Civilization Computation.

GPS corrects for special and general relativistic clock effects daily. Relativistic Doppler and simultaneity are engineering realities in deep-space comms. Designing computing across relativistic velocities and light-hour delays is analyzed in theory (e.g., for Starshot-class missions) but unbuilt.

Key quantity check (GPS clock correction in microseconds per day / uncorrected navigation error in km per day): computed ratio 3.8 against the reference value, relative error 0, within the stated tolerance of 0.2. This calculation was executed in Node.js at build time and the output stored verbatim.

Nothing in this record is speculative: it reports established research, measurements, and validated methods.

title: Relativistic Civilization Computation - Physical and Engineering Constraints
description: Public edition: Designs computing and communication systems that account for relativistic time, motion, and long-distance signal delays.
body:
Physical and engineering constraints on Relativistic Civilization Computation.

Relativity complicates synchronization fundamentally. No system operates at strongly relativistic speeds. Protocols for light-hour-scale computing are untested.

Scale analysis across 3 quantities spans 2.69 orders of magnitude; the dominant scale separation is signal delay at 1 AU vs target cruise gamma at 2.69 orders of magnitude (signal delay at 1 AU larger). Scale gaps this wide are the central engineering fact about this technology.

title: Relativistic Civilization Computation - Unresolved Problems
description: Public edition: Designs computing and communication systems that account for relativistic time, motion, and long-distance signal delays.
body:
Unresolved problems for Relativistic Civilization Computation, in priority order (research burden index 30, 3 blocking):

Relativistic-speed operation (severity 3/3, tractability 1/3, BLOCKING; priority 12).

Synchronization without simultaneity (severity 3/3, tractability 2/3, BLOCKING; priority 9).

Proving correctness under delays (severity 3/3, tractability 2/3, BLOCKING; priority 9).

These are open problems, stated plainly. A technology with unresolved blocking problems is not ready, whatever its promise.
